title: ParseX exportResult Payload
description: Kind-specific payload for kind=exportResult, emitted by 'parsex export' and the MCP export_arxml tool. 'output' is the path the text was written to, or null when it was not written to a file; 'content' carries the exported text and is present only when 'output' is null. 'output' is a deliberate exception to omit-don't-null (CONVENTIONS.md): it states 'not written to a file' explicitly rather than by omission.

sourcePath.description: ARXML file the export was built from.

output.description: Path the exported text was written to; null when it was not written to a file.

warnings.description: Things that could not be resolved during export, and why.

content.description: Exported DBC/CSV text; present only when output is null.
